Class PlayerVirtualView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.controller.PlayerVirtualView
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameObserver
public class PlayerVirtualView extends Object implements GameObserver
Server-side GameObserver that translates model events into network messages sent to a client. It sits between the GameModel and a single ClientConnection: whenever the model changes it fires a GameEvent, and this class reacts by building the right ServerMessage (carrying the relevant DTO snapshot) and pushing it over the connection.

Events are routed through a dispatch map from GameEvent to a handler Runnable, so onModelChanged(GameEvent) simply looks the event up and runs its handler. Events without a registered handler (e.g. ERA_CHANGED) intentionally produce no message, because their information already travels inside another update such as a round-ended snapshot.

The helper methods extract the parts of the model that the client needs as serializable DTOs (board rows as card-id lists, per-player stats, totem positions), keeping full model objects on the server side.
